query: Move my run planned for Thursday to Friday, same time.
expected_behavior: Finds the target with list_training_targets, then reads it with get_training_target
Calls update_training_target with the name, sport, time and every phase carried over from the read-back; only the date changes
Takes each phase's goal from goalType, so a distance phase is not sent as a duration goal

query: Plan 4x8 min on the bike at 250 W next Tuesday at 7am with 3 min easy between.
expected_behavior: Calls get_training_zones with the cycling sport_id before choosing a zone
Uses the power_zone whose [min, max) range contains 250 W, not a guess from percentages
Creates one repeat phase with reps 4, goal.duration_s 480 and recovery.duration_s 180

query: I think I forgot to log yesterday's run, should I?
expected_behavior: Does not call create_training_session
May read list_training_sessions to check, then offers to log it and asks for the details
Finds the favorite_id with list_favorites
Uses rename_favorite, not update_favorite

query: Put three easy 40-minute runs in my diary on Monday, Wednesday and Friday next week.
expected_behavior: Confirms the plan once before writing
Creates the targets one at a time and reports each id
Ends with list_training_targets over that week

query: Plan my half-marathon on 25 October at 9:00: km 1-5 in low Z3, km 5-15 between Z1 and Z3, then the last 6.1 km free, Z4 allowed.
expected_behavior: Calls create_training_target with three block phases goaled by distance_m (5000, 10000, 6100), not a repeat and not a duration
Sets intensity hr_zone 3 on the first block, and zone ranges with zone_max on the others (hr_zone 1 + zone_max 3, hr_zone 3 + zone_max 4)
Does not tell the user that distance segments or zone ranges are unsupported

query: Change my brick on Saturday: the bike part should be 2 x 20 min in power zone 3 with 5 min easy between, keep the run as is.
expected_behavior: Reads the target with get_training_target before updating
Calls update_training_target with exercises listing both sports in the stored order, the run carried over unchanged
Builds the bike part as a repeat of 2 with a 20 min power_zone 3 work phase and a 5 min recovery

query: Put a 10 km in 45 minutes pace target on Sunday at 8:00.
expected_behavior: Calls create_training_target with both duration_s 2700 and distance_m 10000 and no phases
Does not convert the request into speed zones or a phased workout
